_comment: Every falsifiable claim Pollis's public material makes about how Pollis works (#1723), and the code that makes it true.
locator.quote is the exact sentence in `doc` (matched on visible text: tags, entities, ** and whitespace normalised, scripts/lib/doc-text.mjs).
anchors are the paths/globs whose change could make the claim false; evidence is the path:line it was checked against at verified_sha.
fact names the scripts/facts.json entry when a number is involved; that checker owns the value.
status: verified | unverifiable (note says what evidence would settle it) | disputed (a policy page that disagrees with code; the owner decides, #1720).
scripts/check-claims.mjs (CI) fails on a deleted anchor or a reworded quote; scripts/claims-impact.mjs --since <ref> lists claims whose anchors changed; /sweep-claims re-verifies them.
